description: This file defines the NoteHistory class, which manages historical note sessions within the Notesnook project. It includes methods for adding, retrieving, cleaning up, removing, and restoring note history sessions, and interacts with database collections and session content.

classes.name: NoteHistory
classes.description: Class managing the history of notes, including adding, retrieving, cleaning up old versions, removing, and restoring note sessions.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the collection and session content.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a filtered selector for note history sessions by noteId.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new note session or updates an existing one, then cleans up old versions.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes old note history sessions exceeding the maximum version limit.

methods.name: content
methods.description: Retrieves the content of a specific session.

methods.name: session
methods.description: Retrieves a specific session by sessionId.

methods.name: clearSessions
methods.description: Deletes all sessions for given noteIds.

methods.name: _remove
methods.description: Internal method to delete a session and its content.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores a session into the active notes, handling encrypted content if necessary.
